nodes.label: convexHull(pts)
nodes.rationale: Andrew's monotone chain returns the hull counter-clockwise, which is the order the perimeter must be traced in; collinear and duplicate points collapse to the extremes so degenerate member sets render as a segment instead of a zero-area crossed path.

nodes.label: esc() HTML-Escape Helper
nodes.rationale: All untrusted graph data (labels, ids, source paths) is HTML-escaped before being injected into innerHTML, preventing XSS from scraped or added sources.

nodes.label: hyperedges Array
nodes.rationale: The generated page ships an empty hyperedge array while still emitting the shaded-region renderer, so the region feature is present but unused for this build.

nodes.label: graphify-theme-init Script
nodes.rationale: The saved theme is applied before first paint so the reader never sees a flash of the wrong theme; with no stored choice the historical dark look is kept, and 'system' follows prefers-color-scheme.

nodes.label: vis-network 9.1.6
nodes.rationale: The viewer is a self-contained static page that pulls vis-network from a CDN with an SRI integrity hash, so the report opens offline-free of any build step.

nodes.label: Fermat/Golden-Angle Spiral Node Seeding
nodes.rationale: Seeding positions on a golden-angle spiral spreads nodes before physics runs, avoiding the near-zero-distance repulsion that made avoidOverlap blow the BarnesHut recursion into a stack overflow on large graphs; small graphs still settle identically.

nodes.label: Theme Toggle (Light/Dark/System)
nodes.rationale: Light/Dark/System is persisted in localStorage so the report matches the reader's environment across reloads, and 'system' is resolved live via prefers-color-scheme change events.

nodes.label: Escaped Delegated Neighbor-Link Handling
nodes.rationale: Inline onclick handlers were replaced by a delegated document listener with esc() on data-nid: a node id from a scraped URL can contain a double quote, and dropping it unescaped into a quoted onclick both broke every link and allowed stored XSS (#1838).
